action: Adds a new low-res sphere under the head (Sphere.004) and Grab-stretches it into a long torso.
reader_equivalent: bpy add uv_sphere below head, scale z up; sculpt_strokes brush=grab downward

action: Pulls shoulders out of the torso with Snake Hook, then shapes back and waist with Grab from behind.
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=snake_hook from shoulder point outward; brush=grab on back

action: Adds an upper-arm sphere (Sphere.005), stretches it into a tube, and a mirrored copy appears on the other side.
tool: Sculpt Mode / Grab on new sphere
reader_equivalent: bpy add uv_sphere, scale to tube, sculpt_strokes grab; duplicate with scale.x=-1

action: Pulls the neck down from the head with Grab to meet the torso.
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=grab on head base downward

action: In Object Mode selects the torso (orange outline) to check it as a separate object, then Grab-adjusts the head.
tool: Object Mode / select; Sculpt Mode / Grab
reader_equivalent: bpy select object Sphere.004; sculpt_strokes grab on head

action: Back to Grab to tweak the arm shape after painting.
Hide the tank top and Grab the body (Sphere.004/.005) chest, neck, chin underside and shoulder.
view: front, low angle from below, front

action: Grab the body torso side and back.
